title: Playtest

start.hint: Shuffle and draw your opening hand of seven cards.

trialCards.hint: Try new cards: choose up to {max} main-deck cards to start in your opening hand. The rest of the hand is drawn at random.
trialCards.limit: You can choose up to {max} cards.
trialCards.emptyDeck: The main deck has no cards to choose.
trialCards.recordBlocked: This game started with chosen cards, so it is not saved as a playtest session.

mulliganHint: {bottom, plural, =0 {free: new seven} other {new seven, # to the bottom}}

bottom.prompt: {count, plural, one {Choose # card to put on the bottom of your library.} other {Choose # cards to put on the bottom of your library, in the order they go.}}
bottom.confirm: {count, plural, one {Put # card on the bottom} other {Put # cards on the bottom}}

commandZone.title: Command zone
commandZone.empty: Empty. Return your commander from the graveyard or exile.

commanderDamage.title: Commander damage
commanderDamage.hint: Record the combat damage each of your commanders deals to each imagined opponent. 21 from one commander loses them the game.

designations.title: Player counters and designations
designations.hint: Set what your cards give you. Each change is one step that undo reverses.
designations.add: Add one {counter, select, poison {poison} energy {energy} other {experience}} counter
designations.remove: Remove one {counter, select, poison {poison} energy {energy} other {experience}} counter
designations.monarch: {has, select, yes {You are the monarch} other {You are not the monarch}}
designations.initiative: {has, select, yes {You have the initiative} other {You do not have the initiative}}
designations.ring: {count, plural, =0 {The Ring has not tempted you} one {The Ring has tempted you once} other {The Ring has tempted you # times}}
designations.dayNight: {state, select, day {It is day} night {It is night} other {Neither day nor night}}
designations.blessing: {has, select, yes {You have the city's blessing} other {You do not have the city's blessing}}

hotkeys.title: Playtest keys
hotkeys.intro: Press a key while the focus is not in a text field. Move keys act on the card that has the focus in your hand or on the battlefield. Escape closes this list.
hotkeys.singleKeysOff: Single-key shortcuts are off, so only Ctrl+Z and ⌘Z work. Turn them back on from the deck builder's keyboard shortcuts.

actions.toGraveyard: Put the focused card into your graveyard
actions.toBattlefield: Put the focused card onto the battlefield
actions.toHand: Return the focused card to your hand
actions.undo: Undo the last step of the game

log.title: Action log
log.placeholder: Record a manual action, such as mana produced
log.empty: Actions will appear here as you play.
log.copyFailed: Could not copy the log. Download the text file instead.
log.evidence: {draws, plural, one {# draw} other {# draws}} · {mana} mana · {seen, plural, one {# card seen} other {# cards seen}}
log.evidenceLimit: Additional cards seen only; free-form notes are not counted.

history.title: This deck's record
history.methodology: Self-reported solitaire results, not tournament win rates.
history.mulliganLabel: {count, plural, =0 {No mulligan} one {# mulligan} other {# mulligans}}

comparison.title: Compare deck versions
comparison.speedValue: {delta, number, maximumFractionDigits-1} turns {direction, select, faster {faster} other {slower}}
comparison.mulliganValue: {delta, number, maximumFractionDigits-1} {direction, select, fewer {fewer} other {more}} mulligans
comparison.sampleSize: {before, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} before · {after, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} after
comparison.earlySignal: Early signal — record at least 3 runs per version before drawing conclusions.
comparison.methodology: Directional, self-reported playtest evidence. It is not a tournament win rate.

proposedChangePlaceholder: What will you change for the next run?
